payload.title: Candidate store for alternative visuals (hero images and diagrams) for A/B testing
payload.description:
Reported by the Machines on Machines story-development session on CLI 5.105.0. MoM will soon A/B test with Google Analytics and wants extra hero images and diagrams per article.

Related: PPY-6f9fb906 (step 5, ImageCandidate for generation rounds and review), PPY-c101a6f9 (generated image candidates), PPY-74ef89b9 (figures). Decide first whether the step-5 ImageCandidate record can serve as this store (candidates per Story kept after a choice) rather than adding a second model. Dependencies: the image epic PPY-0111742e; none on the guidelines epic PPY-2a2a8a.

Observed: images figure add and images list answer 'not built yet'. The agent stored two cover candidates by saving an unpublished draft version. That workaround must not be repeated.

Feature: Candidates for a Story's visuals
  Scenario: Add a candidate
    Given a Story with a live cover
    When an editor or agent adds an alternative hero image or diagram with a reason
    Then the candidate is stored for the Story with who added it, when, and why
    And the live cover is unchanged
  Scenario: Choose one live
    Given a Story with several candidates
    When a person chooses one
    Then it becomes the live visual and the others are kept
  Scenario: List candidates
    Given a Story with candidates
    When images list is run for the Story
    Then each candidate shows its kind, who, when, why and whether it is live
  Scenario: No draft versions as storage
    Given an agent wants to keep an alternative
    Then it adds a candidate and never saves an unpublished Story version

Design: keep it simple. Picture and diagram text/files in S3; the catalog holds one small row per candidate (story, kind, who, when, why, live flag, S3 key). Follow-up question, not in scope: how a GA experiment variant assignment reaches the page (build-time variants, client swap, or edge); decide after the store exists.
